title: Rustorio recipe
description: content/recipes/*.json — the file name is the recipe's id unless "path" overrides it.

path.description: Optional. Defaults to the file's own name without .json.

items.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference.

output.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference.

kind.description: A BuildingType name (MINER, FURNACE, PRESS, ASSEMBLER, ...) for that kind's shared pool, or a reference to a building's own private pool.
